messages:
mike_devex: Heads up — seeing interrupted streaming when using the SDK behind our credential-proxy. Async generator yields one chunk then stops. Anyone seen this?

anya_sdk: Hmm, what SDK version & install method? poetry/pip/lockfile can change httpx/transitions.

mike_devex: Using poetry v1.4, lockfile from CI, py sdk 0.14.2, httpx 0.24.0 (from lock). Running `credential-proxy` that injects Authorization and mTLS between app and Redwood. Non-async requests are fine.

sam_infra: Can you paste tiny repro? Also does the proxy stream chunked responses correctly? It might close connection early.

mike_devex: ```py
# minimal repro snippet
from redwood import AsyncClient

async with AsyncClient() as c:
    async for msg in c.stream("chat.completions", model="redwood-small", prompt="hi"):
        print(msg)
# headers: Authorization: Bearer <token> (injected by proxy)
```

anya_sdk: Two quick suspects: httpx/httpcore version mismatch with the proxy, and our SDK's EOF handling for streaming. Try pinning `httpcore==0.16.3` OR downgrade httpx to `0.23.3` which we validated with credential-proxy.

jordan_reliability: Also check retries — our retry middleware will attempt a retry on some 5xx variants which can interact badly with streaming. If the proxy returns an early 502 then closes, the retry behavior may leave the consumer with an incomplete stream.

lydia_research: I hit something similar last month. Workaround that helped: set `timeout=None` + use an AsyncClient configured with `stream=True`, and disable automatic retries at the transport layer while testing. Ugly but it isolates the issue.

mike_devex: Quick test: pinned httpx to 0.23.3 in dev env, streaming now continuous. Can someone confirm if this is an SDK bug we should patch or just a doc for proxy caveats?

anya_sdk: Thanks — file an issue? If pin fixes it we'll push a patch and a release note. Also we'll add a better log/error when streams end early (include proxy response details).

deploy-bot: deploy:noticed:new-py-sdk-0.14.3 published 2m — contains httpx compatibility fix.

anya_sdk: :thumbsup: I'll add a short note to the SDK docs and open PR to catch early EOFs. Can you paste the (sanitized) proxy config here so infra can reproduce?

mike_devex: Will DM the proxy config and paste minimal sanitized snippet here later. Thanks all.
